envelope.task: ADEQUATE means the observable record supports a risk assessment, including lawful behavior or reliably observed absence. If relevant evidence is insufficient, use INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. Missingness and omitted facts are distinct. Follow recorded order; render order is not chronology.
